A Beninese benchmark, from the continent to global markets

BADSAL & FILS OKIKIOLA is a Beninese benchmark connecting the continent's resources to global markets. Since its founding, the company has worked with international clients and investors, responding to their specific needs.

Learn more →

Export: Agro-industry

We export exceptional tropical, agri-food and derived products worldwide: pineapple, shea, cassava, palm nuts, cashew, soy, mango, avocado, sesame, groundnut, honey, dried fruit, animal feed, mineral resources, powders, oils and cocoa butter.

Learn more →

Import: Construction, Electrical & Staple Foods

We import staple foods — rice, sugar, cooking oils and spaghetti — as well as construction and electrical materials: reinforcing steel, copper, electrical wires, plaster and pipes, adapted to local needs.
